none: PAS CAM-950062: Roman Coin : Copper alloy Nummus of Constantine II
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Nummus of Constantine II. Mint is Lyons AD332, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows 2 Soldiers, 2 Standards. See RIC VII, p.138, no.255. Obverse shows Laureate ,cuirassed bust right. Obverse reads FL IVL CONSTANTINVS NOB C. Reverse fields and exergue read: -/-// ( )PLG . Condition is fine, die axis 12 o,clock. Weight 2.26g, diameter 16.74mm
